notes: BESIII search for ALP in J/psi -> gamma a, a -> gamma gamma using 2.71e9 psi(3686) events. New observed 95% CL upper limits on g_agamma over 0.165-2.84 GeV/c^2 (excluding pi0/eta/eta' windows). Coupling type is unambiguous (AxionPhoton), but the paper provides no numerical table of g_agamma vs m_a; only anchor values are given in text: g_agamma > 3e-4 GeV^-1 excluded near m_a = 0.25 GeV, B(J/psi->gamma a) limits ranging 8.3e-8 to 1.8e-6, converted via Eq.(1) with B(J/psi->ee)=5.971%. Data points are approximate reconstructions from these anchors and the exclusion plot shape; high-mass points are least reliable due to the (1-m_a^2/m_Jpsi^2)^-3 enhancement. Not a DM haloscope, so no DM density assumption. Most stringent limits to date for 0.165 <= m_a <= 1.468 GeV/c^2.
